entries.title: 5G: The new network arrives
entries.quote: DELOITTE GLOBAL PREDICTS that 2019 will be the year in which fifth-generation (5G) wide-area wireless networks arrive in scale. ... by the end of 2019, we expect 25 operators to have launched 5G service in at least part of their territory
entries.subject: 5G networks
entries.note: Same chapter: about 1 million 5G handsets shipped by end-2019, about 20 handset vendors launching 5G handsets.

entries.title: Artificial intelligence: From expert-only to everywhere
entries.quote: Deloitte Global predicts that by 2020, penetration rates of enterprise software with integrated AI and cloud based AI platforms will reach an estimated 87 percent and 83 percent, respectively, among companies that use AI software.
entries.metric: penetration of enterprise software with integrated AI among AI-using companies
entries.subject: Cloud AI and enterprise AI software

entries.title: Smart speakers: Growth at a discount
entries.quote: DELOITTE GLOBAL PREDICTS that the industry for smart speakers ... will be worth US$7 billion in 2019, selling 164 million units at an average selling price of US$43.
entries.subject: Smart speakers

entries.title: Does TV sports have a future? Bet on it
entries.quote: DELOITTE GLOBAL PREDICTS that in 2019, 60 percent of North American men aged 18–34 who watch sports on TV will also bet on sports—and the more often they bet, the more TV sports they'll watch.
entries.metric: North American male 18-34 TV sports viewers who bet on sports
entries.subject: Sports betting and TV sports
entries.note: The chapter carries some 15 further sub-predictions on US TV and sports viewing; only the headline is captured.

entries.title: On your marks, get set, game! eSports and the shape of media in 2019
entries.quote: DELOITTE GLOBAL PREDICTS that in 2019, the North American market for eSports will expand by 35 percent, driven by advertising, broadcast licensing, and franchise sales.
entries.subject: eSports

entries.title: Radio: Revenue, reach, and resilience
entries.quote: DELOITTE GLOBAL PREDICTS that global radio revenue will reach US$40 billion in 2019, a 1 percent increase over 2018.
entries.subject: Radio

entries.title: 3D printing growth accelerates again
entries.quote: DELOITTE GLOBAL PREDICTS that sales related to 3D printing ... by large public companies—including enterprise 3D printers, materials, and services—will surpass US$2.7 billion in 2019 and top US$3 billion in 2020.
entries.metric: 3D printing sales by large public companies
entries.subject: 3D printing

entries.title: China, by design: World-leading connectivity nurtures new digital business models
entries.quote: DELOITTE GLOBAL PREDICTS that China will have world-leading telecommunications networks in 2019 and most likely in the medium term. ... In China, 600 million people will use their phones to make mobile payments as of the start of 2019
entries.metric: people in China using mobile payments
entries.subject: China digital infrastructure

entries.title: China inside: Chinese semiconductors will power artificial intelligence
entries.quote: DELOITTE GLOBAL PREDICTS that revenues for semiconductors manufactured in China will grow by 25 percent to approximately US$110 billion in 2019 from an estimated US$85 billion in 2018
entries.metric: revenue of semiconductors manufactured in China
entries.subject: Chinese semiconductors

entries.title: Quantum computers: The next supercomputers, but not the next laptops
entries.quote: The quantum computer market of the future will be about the size of today's supercomputer market—around US$50 billion.
entries.subject: Quantum computing
entries.note: No target year; the chapter frames the horizon as 2030 and beyond.

notes: 18th edition ('now in its 18th year'). Ten chapters. PDF from deloitte.com/content/dam/insights. Publication month from the December launch pattern; exact day not confirmed. Rank is the order in the report.
